title: blucon - readings stopped
symptom: Using with blucon nightrider and libre, all of a sudden readings stopped, no readings coming, signal missed. Battery status has a strike across and always shows 100%, never changed since a week of usage or maybe nine days.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. Possible causes mentioned include dead BluCon battery, Bluetooth connection issues, or the BluCon reader not being able to read. One user suspects a bug, and another suggests the battery dies suddenly after about 16 days.
fix: The thread does not provide a definitive fix. Workarounds mentioned include replacing the battery, restarting the phone, deleting cache and preferences of xDrip, enabling Aggressive Service Restart, and deleting xDrip data on a Wear SmartWatch if present. However, these did not consistently resolve the issue.
evidence_quote: if not done, please enabled Agressive service Restart. if you have a wear SmartWatch, it could be the problem. try deleting xdrip data on Watch. when battery at 3 percent, simply change it. Blucon doesn't deliver proper battery info.
